can you wirte me a poweshell script to copy all rows conatinig the text "julia" form data.csv to loan.csv and just the date and amoiunt columns


---

_**Agent (gpt-5.6-sol 2026-08-03 08:24:38Z)**_

```powershell
Import-Csv .\data.csv |
    Where-Object { ($_ | ConvertTo-Csv -NoTypeInformation)[1] -match 'julia' } |
    Select-Object Date, Amount |
    Export-Csv .\loan.csv -NoTypeInformation
```

Save as `copy-julia-transactions.ps1` in the same folder as `data.csv`, then run:

```powershell
.\copy-julia-transactions.ps1
```

This matches `julia` case-insensitively anywhere in each row and writes only the `Date` and `Amount` columns to `loan.csv`. Ensure those column names match the CSV headers exactly.
